entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, [And] His praise in the assembly of saints.

entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: Let them praise His name with the dance; Let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the humble with salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Let the saints be joyful in glory; Let them sing aloud on their beds.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: ¶[Let] the high praises of God [be] in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand,

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: To execute vengeance on the nations, And punishments on the peoples;

entries.title: Psalms 149:8
segments: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: To execute on them the written judgment-This honor have all His saints. Praise the LORD!
